# Next source-backed coordinate issue

right (or right+down) input frames followed by30 release/deceleration frames.

retained root is-170.55 and the source Point projected into that field is170.55.
The0.6 difference follows from raw `p[axis] += v` versus source compound
DisplayObject setters. This is native observation plus qualified setter/Point
mechanics, not original World.Run evidence or a completed repair.

Original `BTAGameWorld.as:1348` AdjustBubblefieldObjects writes current root
X/Y, current under-avatar X/Y, background services, then sibling copies and masks.
It does not accumulate a separate logical avatar position. Original
`SnapBackAllObject` at1334 projects World.myAvatar X/Y through actual
localToGlobal then currentBFTarget.globalToLocal. `_‑Zx._‑QH` at720–730 similarly
projects World.myAvatar through World and the actual parent for behavior turns.
`MoveAvatarToNewBubblefieldLocation` at1201 recomputes its next-detail marker
Point every Run; `_‑VS` at232 and `_‑0Z` at1008 use World-local marker/actual
avatar coordinates. Current tickTransit instead compares raw `tr.target` and
logical player values, increments those logical values independently, and
subtracts a map offset at arrival.

Candidate fifth layer: make the existing avatar field-coordinate simulation
bridge read actual retained World/field Point conversions; refresh after source
moves, during field Run contexts and at promotion. Preserve motion Number units
and setter order; do not quantize velocity or derive from a view camera. Numeric
inverse qualification is a separate running child. Legacy live width/spacing,
complete field geometry and unsupported event/ordinary/Adobe scopes remain open.
Do not silently claim that this proposal is implemented or that either layer is
published before its source and browser gate.
EOF
